definitions.explanation: A television or radio station; the organization or facility that produces and transmits broadcast content. Composed of 放送 (broadcasting) + 局 (bureau/station).

examples.japanese: この{放送局|ほうそうきょく}はニュースで{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: This broadcasting station is famous for its news.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{放送局|ほうそうきょく}が{祭|まつ}りの{様子|ようす}を{中継|ちゅうけい}した。
examples.english: The local broadcasting station aired a live broadcast of the festival.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{大学|だいがく}{卒業|そつぎょう}{後|ご}、テレビ{放送局|ほうそうきょく}に{就職|しゅうしょく}した。
examples.english: After graduating from university, he got a job at a television broadcasting station.

notes:
USAGE:
{放送局|ほうそうきょく} can refer to both the organization and the physical building/facility. It covers both television and radio broadcasting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- テレビ{放送局|ほうそうきょく} (television station)
- ラジオ{放送局|ほうそうきょく} (radio station)
- {民間|みんかん}{放送局|ほうそうきょく} (private broadcasting station)
- {地元|じもと}の{放送局|ほうそうきょく} (local station)
- {放送局|ほうそうきょく}に{勤|つと}める (work at a broadcasting station)

SIMILAR WORDS:
テレビ{局|きょく} is a shorter, more casual way to say "TV station." {放送|ほうそう} alone means "broadcast" or "broadcasting" as an activity.
